purpose: Joins two to five related actions or views into one control that shares a surface and an outer edge, such as Previous, Today, Next or Day, Week, Month. The group sets every segment's Variant and Size.

notFor.case: One primary action with related alternatives behind a menu.
Switching between two or three short, mutually exclusive views where one must always be chosen.
Unrelated actions that only happen to sit side by side.

Default.meaning: The group has no states of its own; each segment carries its own (ButtonGroupItem).
Default.visual: Segments share the outer radius; outline draws a Border/control edge around the group; a ButtonGroupDivider sits between segments.

a11y.role: group, with an aria-label supplied by the app
a11y.keyboard: Tab moves through the segments one by one; Enter or Space activates the focused one (native buttons).
notes: A selected segment carries aria-pressed (ButtonGroupItem active).

openQuestions: Keyboard: should the group be one tab stop with arrow keys between segments (toolbar pattern), or keep one tab stop per segment as now?
Selection: when segments act as views (Day · Week · Month), may more than one be active at once, and who enforces it?
